properties.summary: Illustrative massing: the two approved three-story PDR buildings, each drawn over its whole lot at 97 ft (115 ft with rooftop structures). The buildings nearly fill their lots; their edges and rounded ramp corners aren't traced. Interstate 280 passes overhead between them.
properties.note: The approved buildings as simple volumes on their lots, not the final design.
properties.license: Heights: from a public SF Planning document. Lots: DataSF parcels (ODC-PDDL).

properties.label: Building A
properties.use: Production, distribution and repair (PDR) space on three levels, with ground-floor retail and maker space, a logistics yard and an active roof for parking and vehicle staging
properties.source: illustrative: the DataSF lot (5284A/008) at the 97-ft height in the San Francisco Gateway Project Draft EIR (Case No. 2015-012491ENV, August 2, 2023), Section 2.D.1 and Table 2.D-1 (PDF pp. 90-91)
properties.note: Building A (749 Toland Street): about 1,080,000 gsf including its active roof (Table 2.D-1). Drawn over the whole lot; the building nearly fills it (Figures 2.D-1 and 2.D-3). Rooftop solar, stair and elevator structures reach 115 ft.
